summary: Implemented parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError in rdflib/extras/shacl.py, with tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (42 tests) under the provided venv. Nothing was committed. A None or non-node input is guarded with a Node check before graph lookups, since Graph.value treats None as a wildcard. black, isort, and mypy are not installed in the venv, so formatting and type checks were not run; line lengths were checked by hand (all within 88).
